summary: A container that groups related settings rows together with consistent spacing and borders.
description: An element used to group combinations of moz-box-item, moz-box-link, and moz-box-button elements and provide the expected styles, including optional list/reorderable-list layout.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of the group, either "list", "reorderable-list", or undefined. Note that "reorderable-list" only works with moz-box-item elements for now.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Slot for rendering various moz-box-* elements.

slots.name: static
slots.description: Slot for rendering non-reorderable moz-box-item elements.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Slot for header content, rendered above the list.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Slot for footer content, rendered below the list.

slots.name: <index>
slots.description: Slots used to assign moz-box-* elements to <li> elements when the group is type="list".

slots.name: static-<index>
slots.description: Slots used to render moz-box-item elements that are not intended to be reorderable when the group is type="reorderable-list".

events.name: reorder
events.description: Fired when items are reordered via drag-and-drop or keyboard shortcuts. Detail contains draggedElement, targetElement, position, draggedIndex, targetIndex, and insertAt.

events.name: scroll
events.description: Re-dispatched on the host when a scroll container in the shadow tree scrolls, so light DOM listeners can observe scrolls that wouldn't otherwise cross the shadow boundary.

methods.name: getMozBoxElement
methods.description: Returns the moz-box element for a list item: either the item itself if it matches, or the first moz-box descendant (e.g. when the item is a setting-control wrapper).

methods.name: restoreTabindex
methods.description: Resets the tabindex on an item so it participates in focus traversal again.

methods.name: updateOptionRole
methods.description: Sets role="option" on the item's underlying moz-box element when the group renders as a reorderable list, and removes it otherwise.

methods.name: reorderArrayFromEvent
methods.description: Reorders an array based on the reorder event, for consumers that store items in an array.

methods.name: handleReorder
methods.description: Handles reordering of items in the list from a moz-reorderable-list event.
